name: Coral Chandelier Ballroom
description: An underwater ballroom lit by living coral chandeliers, with fish drifting like guests.
prompt: A single breathtaking underwater ballroom scene: grand arched hall made of pale coral and sea glass, enormous chandeliers formed from luminous coral branches and pearl strands, tiny tropical fish drifting like dancers, shafts of turquoise sunlight piercing from above, sandy floor with ripples, elegant and magical, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: The ocean’s most elegant ballroom has no doors — only currents. 🐠✨
